sentences.text: 3. The learned counsel for the parties would submit that the matter has been settled between them and have filed an application seeking compounding of offences along with affidavit of respondent No.2.

The same read as follows:
"JOINT AFFIDAVIT I, Poojashree.

M.K W/o Ravi C.M, Aged about 26 years, R/at No.27, Herohalli, Maruthinagara, NC: 2024:KHC:41187 Bengaluru 560 091, do hereby solemnly affirm and state on oath as follows:
1. I submit that I am the respondent No. 2 in the above case and I am well conversant with the facts and circumstances of this case.
Hence, I am swearing to this affidavit.

2. I submit that, the above petition is filed by the petitioners seeking quashing of the entire proceedings in C.C. No. 11797/2023 including the FIR, Compliant and Charge Sheet on the file of the Hon'ble Court of Chief Judicial Magistra5te Rural Court,
Bengaluru Rural, Bengaluru, for the offences punishable under sections 498A, 506 R/w sections 149 of Indian Penal Code and Sections 3 and 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act 1961.

3. I submit that, the criminal proceedings in C.C. No. 11797/2023 including the FIR,
Compliant and Charge Sheet on the file of the Hon'ble Court of Chief Judicial Magistrate Rural Court, Bengaluru Rural, Bengaluru, was initiated by me at the heat of the moment and I had no intention to give it a criminal color as I was very much ignorant regarding the consequences of the said proceedings and had never thought the same would go to this extent, which I certainly regret.

sentences.text: I submit that, I alongwith the petitioner No.1 are residing together under a single roof since May 2023 leading a happy and prosperous life by putting aside our differences and egos.
We are blessed with a daughter from the said matrimony and accordingly we are dedicated to give a good life to the said child and are focused on achieving the same.
As of now there are no differences between us and we are leading a prosperous marital life since then.

I submit that I am well aware of the initiation of the above proceedings seeking to quash the entire proceedings in C.C. No. 11797/2023 including the FIR, Compliant and Charge Sheet on the file of the Hon'ble Court of Chief Judicial Magistrate Rural Court which was initiated by me and I am also aware of the facts and circumstances of the above proceedings and I have full consent to quash the same from my own volition.

6. I submit that, I have already forego the past incidents and I am continuing my marital relationship with the petitioner No.1 for the past one year and since then he is looking after me with love and affection and we are ving a normal life by keeping our differences apart in order to give our daughter a good life which she deserves.
7.

I submit that, under the circumstances and for the reasons stated above the proceedings in C.C.
No. 11797/2023 on the file of the Hon'ble Court of Chief Judicial Magistrate Rural Court, Bengaluru,

information and belief.

4. In the light of the settlement arrived at between the parties and the offences not being against the State, I deem it NC: 2024:KHC:41187 appropriate to accept the application seeking compounding of the offences and terminate the proceedings, qua the petitioners.
5. For the aforesaid reasons, the criminal petition is disposed.
The proceedings in C.C.No.11797/2023 pending on the file of the Hon'ble Court of Chief Judicial Magistrate Rural Court, Bengaluru, stand quashed.
